"''Maybe it's another drill.|The stormtrooper and their partner|audio=KE-829.flac|}} A '''stormtrooper''' served aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]] in [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1}} being on guard duty near [[Tractor Beam 12]] when the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' arrived on the [[battle station]]. As [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] deactivated Tractor Beam 12, they overheard the [[stormtrooper]] and [[Unidentified stormtrooper (BT-16)|their partner]] having a conversation about the [[BT-16]]. Using [[the Force]], Kenobi was able to confuse the two troopers by tricking this trooper into thinking there was something behind them, and escape the area undetected. The trooper ultimately attributed it to nothing more than outgassing. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{GoS|Light Side (episode)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი შტურმტრუპერი (მიზიდვის სხივი 12) }} [[Category:Death Star residents]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
